resources.name: High-throughput DFT calculations of formation energy, stability and oxygen vacancy formation energy of ABO3 perovskites

access.notes: Emery & Wolverton (2017) dataset containing 5276 ABO3 perovskites with formation energies, stability, volumes, lattice parameters, ionic radii, band gaps, and vacancy energies.
Python machine learning library for SVM, RF, RR, preprocessing, and grid search.
Choose one of PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn's MLPRegressor to implement the back-propagation neural network.
